description: This file defines a PHP class 'ValidationUserNameAPI' in the 'OrangeHRM' project. The class provides an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of a username within the Human Resource Management system. It includes request handling, validation rules, and integration with user service methods to check username availability.

classes.name: ValidationUserNameAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating username availability, extending the Endpoint class and implementing ResourceEndpoint, providing methods for request validation and response formatting.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate if a username is unique, optionally checking against a given user ID, and returns the validation result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides request validation rules for the getOne method, including string length and optional user ID.
